```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  cache = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 4
)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(brms)
  library(glmmTMB)
  library(knitr)
  library(posterior)
})

options(mc.cores = min(2, parallel::detectCores()))
brms_backend <- if (requireNamespace("cmdstanr", quietly = TRUE)) "cmdstanr" else "rstan"

fit_brms <- function(formula, data, prior, seed) {
  brm(
    formula = formula,
    data = data,
    family = negbinomial(link = "log"),
    prior = prior,
    chains = 2,
    cores = 2,
    iter = 400,
    warmup = 200,
    seed = seed,
    backend = brms_backend,
    refresh = 0
  )
}

rmvn2 <- function(n, sd_1, sd_2, cor) {
  cov <- matrix(
    c(sd_1^2, cor * sd_1 * sd_2, cor * sd_1 * sd_2, sd_2^2),
    nrow = 2
  )
  matrix(rnorm(n * 2), ncol = 2) %*% chol(cov)
}

make_table <- function(rows) {
  rows[] <- lapply(rows, function(x) if (is.numeric(x)) round(x, 3) else x)
  kable(rows)
}

extract_glmm_us <- function(model, group) {
  vc <- VarCorr(model)$cond[[group]]
  c(
    sd_1 = unname(attr(vc, "stddev")[1]),
    sd_2 = unname(attr(vc, "stddev")[2]),
    cor_12 = unname(attr(vc, "correlation")[1, 2])
  )
}

extract_glmm_decomp <- function(model, group) {
  vc <- VarCorr(model)$cond
  group_names <- grep(paste0("^", group, "(\\.[0-9]+)?$"), names(vc), value = TRUE)
  sd_sum <- unname(attr(vc[[group_names[1]]], "stddev")[1])
  sd_diff <- unname(attr(vc[[group_names[2]]], "stddev")[1])
  var_member <- sd_sum^2 + sd_diff^2
  c(
    sd = sqrt(var_member),
    cor_12 = (sd_sum^2 - sd_diff^2) / var_member
  )
}

extract_brms_re_us <- function(model, group) {
  s <- summary(model)$random[[group]]
  c(
    sd_1 = s["sd(is_male)", "Estimate"],
    sd_2 = s["sd(is_female)", "Estimate"],
    cor_12 = s["cor(is_male,is_female)", "Estimate"]
  )
}

extract_brms_decomp <- function(model, group) {
  draws <- as_draws_df(model)
  sd_sum <- mean(draws[[paste0("sd_", group, "__Intercept")]])
  sd_diff <- mean(draws[[paste0("sd_", group, "__Idiff")]])
  var_member <- sd_sum^2 + sd_diff^2
  c(
    sd = sqrt(var_member),
    cor_12 = (sd_sum^2 - sd_diff^2) / var_member
  )
}

brms_nb_priors_no_intercept <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd"),
  prior(lkj(2), class = "cor"),
  prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = "shape")
)

brms_nb_priors_intercept <- c(
  brms_nb_priors_no_intercept,
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = "Intercept")
)

brms_nb_priors_decomp_intercept <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd"),
  prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = "shape")
)

brms_nb_priors_decomp_intercept_only <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd"),
  prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = "shape")
)
```

For negative-binomial models, the dependence parameters below are latent Gaussian
covariances on the log-link scale, not observed-scale residual covariances.

## Cross-Sectional Distinguishable Dyads

```{r cross-dist-negbin}
set.seed(2101)
n_couples <- 1000
shape <- 20

beta <- c(
  is_male = 0.8,
  is_female = 0.65,
  male_actor = 0.3,
  female_actor = 0.2,
  male_partner = 0.08,
  female_partner = 0.12
)

true_latent <- c(sd_1 = 0.45, sd_2 = 0.35, cor_12 = -0.5)
latent <- rmvn2(n_couples, true_latent["sd_1"], true_latent["sd_2"], true_latent["cor_12"])
x_male <- rnorm(n_couples)
x_female <- rnorm(n_couples)

df <- data.frame(
  coupleID = factor(rep(seq_len(n_couples), each = 2)),
  member = rep(1:2, n_couples),
  is_male = rep(c(1, 0), n_couples),
  is_female = rep(c(0, 1), n_couples)
)

df$x_actor <- ifelse(df$is_male == 1, rep(x_male, each = 2), rep(x_female, each = 2))
df$x_partner <- ifelse(df$is_male == 1, rep(x_female, each = 2), rep(x_male, each = 2))
df$latent <- ifelse(df$is_male == 1, rep(latent[, 1], each = 2), rep(latent[, 2], each = 2))
eta <- with(
  df,
  beta["is_male"] * is_male +
    beta["is_female"] * is_female +
    beta["male_actor"] * is_male * x_actor +
    beta["female_actor"] * is_female * x_actor +
    beta["male_partner"] * is_male * x_partner +
    beta["female_partner"] * is_female * x_partner +
    latent
)
df$y <- rnbinom(nrow(df), mu = exp(eta), size = shape)

model_glmm <- glmmTMB(
  y ~ 0 + is_male + is_female +
    is_male:x_actor + is_female:x_actor +
    is_male:x_partner + is_female:x_partner +
    (0 + is_male + is_female | coupleID),
  data = df,
  family = nbinom2(link = "log")
)

model_brms <- fit_brms(
  bf(
    y ~ 0 + is_male + is_female +
      is_male:x_actor + is_female:x_actor +
      is_male:x_partner + is_female:x_partner +
      (0 + is_male + is_female | coupleID)
  ),
  data = df,
  prior = brms_nb_priors_no_intercept,
  seed = 2101
)

make_table(data.frame(
  parameter = names(true_latent),
  true = unname(true_latent),
  glmmTMB = unname(extract_glmm_us(model_glmm, "coupleID")),
  brms = unname(extract_brms_re_us(model_brms, "coupleID"))
))
```

## Cross-Sectional Exchangeable Dyads

```{r cross-exch-negbin}
set.seed(2102)
n_couples <- 1000
shape <- 20

beta <- c(intercept = 0.75, actor = 0.3, partner = 0.12)
true_latent <- c(sd = 0.45, cor_12 = -0.5)
sd_sum <- sqrt(true_latent["sd"]^2 * (1 + true_latent["cor_12"]) / 2)
sd_diff <- sqrt(true_latent["sd"]^2 * (1 - true_latent["cor_12"]) / 2)
sum_re <- rnorm(n_couples, 0, sd_sum)
diff_re <- rnorm(n_couples, 0, sd_diff)
x_1 <- rnorm(n_couples)
x_2 <- rnorm(n_couples)

df <- data.frame(
  coupleID = factor(rep(seq_len(n_couples), each = 2)),
  member = rep(1:2, n_couples),
  Idiff = rep(c(1, -1), n_couples),
  is_partner1 = rep(c(1, 0), n_couples),
  is_partner2 = rep(c(0, 1), n_couples)
)

df$x_actor <- ifelse(df$is_partner1 == 1, rep(x_1, each = 2), rep(x_2, each = 2))
df$x_partner <- ifelse(df$is_partner1 == 1, rep(x_2, each = 2), rep(x_1, each = 2))
df$latent <- sum_re[as.integer(df$coupleID)] + df$Idiff * diff_re[as.integer(df$coupleID)]
eta <- with(df, beta["intercept"] + beta["actor"] * x_actor + beta["partner"] * x_partner + latent)
df$y <- rnbinom(nrow(df), mu = exp(eta), size = shape)

model_glmm <- glmmTMB(
  y ~ 1 + x_actor + x_partner +
    (1 | coupleID) + (0 + Idiff | coupleID),
  data = df,
  family = nbinom2(link = "log")
)

model_brms <- fit_brms(
  bf(y ~ 1 + x_actor + x_partner + (1 | coupleID) + (0 + Idiff | coupleID)),
  data = df,
  prior = brms_nb_priors_decomp_intercept,
  seed = 2102
)

make_table(data.frame(
  parameter = names(true_latent),
  true = unname(true_latent),
  glmmTMB = unname(extract_glmm_decomp(model_glmm, "coupleID")),
  brms = unname(extract_brms_decomp(model_brms, "coupleID"))
))
```

## ILD Distinguishable Dyads

```{r ild-dist-negbin}
set.seed(2103)
n_couples <- 80
n_days <- 3
shape <- 100

beta <- c(is_male = 0.8, is_female = 0.65)

true_couple <- c(sd_1 = 0.7, sd_2 = 0.6, cor_12 = -0.6)
true_day <- c(sd_1 = 0.8, sd_2 = 0.7, cor_12 = -0.65)
couple_re <- rmvn2(n_couples, true_couple["sd_1"], true_couple["sd_2"], true_couple["cor_12"])

df <- expand.grid(
  coupleID = seq_len(n_couples),
  day = seq_len(n_days),
  member = 1:2
)
df <- df[order(df$coupleID, df$day, df$member), ]
df$coupleID <- factor(df$coupleID)
df$couple_day <- interaction(df$coupleID, df$day, drop = TRUE)
df$day_c <- df$day - mean(seq_len(n_days))
df$is_male <- as.numeric(df$member == 1)
df$is_female <- as.numeric(df$member == 2)

day_re <- rmvn2(n_couples * n_days, true_day["sd_1"], true_day["sd_2"], true_day["cor_12"])
day_index <- (as.integer(df$coupleID) - 1) * n_days + df$day
df$couple_re <- ifelse(df$is_male == 1, couple_re[as.integer(df$coupleID), 1], couple_re[as.integer(df$coupleID), 2])
df$day_re <- ifelse(df$is_male == 1, day_re[day_index, 1], day_re[day_index, 2])
eta <- with(
  df,
  beta["is_male"] * is_male +
    beta["is_female"] * is_female +
    couple_re + day_re
)
df$y <- rnbinom(nrow(df), mu = exp(eta), size = shape)

model_glmm <- glmmTMB(
  y ~ 0 + is_male + is_female +
    (0 + is_male + is_female | coupleID) +
    (0 + is_male + is_female | couple_day),
  data = df,
  family = nbinom2(link = "log")
)

model_brms <- fit_brms(
  bf(
    y ~ 0 + is_male + is_female +
      (0 + is_male + is_female | coupleID) +
      (0 + is_male + is_female | couple_day)
  ),
  data = df,
  prior = brms_nb_priors_no_intercept,
  seed = 2103
)

make_table(rbind(
  data.frame(
    block = "couple",
    parameter = names(true_couple),
    true = unname(true_couple),
    glmmTMB = unname(extract_glmm_us(model_glmm, "coupleID")),
    brms = unname(extract_brms_re_us(model_brms, "coupleID"))
  ),
  data.frame(
    block = "same-day latent",
    parameter = names(true_day),
    true = unname(true_day),
    glmmTMB = unname(extract_glmm_us(model_glmm, "couple_day")),
    brms = unname(extract_brms_re_us(model_brms, "couple_day"))
  )
))
```

## ILD Exchangeable Dyads

```{r ild-exch-negbin}
set.seed(2104)
n_couples <- 80
n_days <- 3
shape <- 100

beta <- c(intercept = 0.75)
true_couple <- c(sd = 0.7, cor_12 = -0.6)
true_day <- c(sd = 0.8, cor_12 = -0.65)

sd_sum_couple <- sqrt(true_couple["sd"]^2 * (1 + true_couple["cor_12"]) / 2)
sd_diff_couple <- sqrt(true_couple["sd"]^2 * (1 - true_couple["cor_12"]) / 2)
sd_sum_day <- sqrt(true_day["sd"]^2 * (1 + true_day["cor_12"]) / 2)
sd_diff_day <- sqrt(true_day["sd"]^2 * (1 - true_day["cor_12"]) / 2)

sum_couple <- rnorm(n_couples, 0, sd_sum_couple)
diff_couple <- rnorm(n_couples, 0, sd_diff_couple)
sum_day <- rnorm(n_couples * n_days, 0, sd_sum_day)
diff_day <- rnorm(n_couples * n_days, 0, sd_diff_day)

df <- expand.grid(
  coupleID = seq_len(n_couples),
  day = seq_len(n_days),
  member = 1:2
)
df <- df[order(df$coupleID, df$day, df$member), ]
df$coupleID <- factor(df$coupleID)
df$couple_day <- interaction(df$coupleID, df$day, drop = TRUE)
df$day_c <- df$day - mean(seq_len(n_days))
df$Idiff <- ifelse(df$member == 1, 1, -1)
df$is_partner1 <- as.numeric(df$member == 1)
df$is_partner2 <- as.numeric(df$member == 2)

day_index <- (as.integer(df$coupleID) - 1) * n_days + df$day
df$couple_re <- sum_couple[as.integer(df$coupleID)] + df$Idiff * diff_couple[as.integer(df$coupleID)]
df$day_re <- sum_day[day_index] + df$Idiff * diff_day[day_index]
eta <- with(df, beta["intercept"] + couple_re + day_re)
df$y <- rnbinom(nrow(df), mu = exp(eta), size = shape)

model_glmm <- glmmTMB(
  y ~ 1 +
    (1 | coupleID) + (0 + Idiff | coupleID) +
    (1 | couple_day) + (0 + Idiff | couple_day),
  data = df,
  family = nbinom2(link = "log")
)

model_brms <- fit_brms(
  bf(
    y ~ 1 +
      (1 | coupleID) + (0 + Idiff | coupleID) +
      (1 | couple_day) + (0 + Idiff | couple_day)
  ),
  data = df,
  prior = brms_nb_priors_decomp_intercept_only,
  seed = 2104
)

make_table(rbind(
  data.frame(
    block = "couple",
    parameter = names(true_couple),
    true = unname(true_couple),
    glmmTMB = unname(extract_glmm_decomp(model_glmm, "coupleID")),
    brms = unname(extract_brms_decomp(model_brms, "coupleID"))
  ),
  data.frame(
    block = "same-day latent",
    parameter = names(true_day),
    true = unname(true_day),
    glmmTMB = unname(extract_glmm_decomp(model_glmm, "couple_day")),
    brms = unname(extract_brms_decomp(model_brms, "couple_day"))
  )
))
```
